label: Apps
description: The look of individual applications. Files (Nautilus): the transparency of its left sidebar and right file list, each on its own, and blur behind the window. GTK reads its style when Files starts, so transparency changes reach open Files windows after Restart Files.

settings.label: Left sidebar transparency
settings.description: 0 % = opaque (the theme's sidebar colour), 100 % = fully clear

settings.label: Right pane transparency
settings.description: The file list and its toolbar. 0 % = opaque (the theme's view colour), 100 % = fully clear

settings.label: Background blur
settings.description: Blurs what is behind the Files window, seen through its transparent parts. Hyprland blurs a whole window with one strength for every window (Glass & transparency → Background blur), so the strength can't differ per pane or per app; an opaque pane simply covers the blur
